01 / THE BRIEF

Say what the company does, clearly.

Xine IT Brains works across skill development infrastructure, CBT examination security and digital transformation. The website needed to explain all of that to a first-time visitor without overwhelming them.

I structured the content and the interface around the company’s professional positioning.

ReactViteJavaScriptGSAPLucide ReactResponsive UI
“A company website should answer ‘what do you do?’ in the first scroll.”
THE BUILD PRINCIPLE
02 / WHAT I BUILT

Component-based and responsive.

The site is built in React with Vite, split into clean, reusable components, with GSAP adding restrained motion.

  • Hero, header and navigation.
  • About Company, Services and Key Offerings sections.
  • Digital Infrastructure, Examination Security, Skill Development Infrastructure and Digital Transformation sections.
  • Image integration and responsive layouts across screen sizes.
Content→Components→Responsive layouts→Motion→Live site
WHAT THIS PROJECT BROUGHT TOGETHER

Structure

Sections organised around the company’s offerings.

Component UI

React components with a consistent visual language.

Responsive build

Layouts that hold up from phone to desktop.

03 / THE TAKEAWAY

What it
taught me.

A corporate site lives or dies on clarity. Working in React and Vite kept the build fast, and the component approach kept the content easy to evolve.
